{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) or shows early negative momentum.",
    "Increase forecast bias correction by 10-15% when true outcome exceeds model forecast by >10% in recent 5-day window.",
    "Apply mean reversion to forecasts when true outcome deviates >15% from 30-day moving average, especially after spikes.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoot after sharp upward spikes (e.g., >15% above recent peak) by 5-10% in next 3-day window.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment when recent true outcomes are trending upward (sentiment > 0.5) and model underperforms.",
    "Apply lag correction: if true outcome is >10% above model forecast, delay next forecast by 1 day and adjust downward by 5%.",
    "When sentiment is consistently positive (0.5+), increase forecast ceiling to avoid underestimating upward momentum.",
    "If model consistently underpredicts true outcomes in 30-day window, apply +3% bias correction to next forecast."
  ]
}
